HistoricalApplicationGrantEvidence.Reason: Provisioning and continuation timestamps are historical; continuation did not inspect current application privileges.

GrantReadiness.RunnerCheck: Rehearsal runner rejects global grants, grant option, unscoped role/grant statements, and grants outside the target schema; it does not compare a minimum privilege allowlist.

ClassificationSemantics.VERIFIED_SCHEMA_SCOPED: Fresh identity-specific evidence shows no effective global privileges, grant option, unrelated schema grant, or unscoped role; this is confinement evidence, not a least-privilege certificate.
ClassificationSemantics.CONFIRMED_OVERPRIVILEGED: Fresh evidence confirms effective global, unrelated-schema, grant-option, or unscoped privilege.
ClassificationSemantics.UNKNOWN/NOT_OBSERVED: No fresh privilege inspection or evidence is historical/ambiguous.
ClassificationSemantics.INSPECTION_FAILED: The bounded inspection could not complete or returned malformed/ambiguous evidence.

GrantReadiness.Remediation: Only if a newly authorized read-only inspection confirms a grant defect; any grant change requires independent operation-specific approval.

ProvisioningWorkflowEvidence.GrantFindingMeaning: Provisioning report records schema-scope check false; this is a historical failed check and does not identify the exact effective privilege set or current state.

RequiredCases.Shape: Active Page with a matching PageRevision; PageCategoryIndexState=Verified and IndexedPageRevision equals Page.Revision; zero PageCategoryMembership rows; stable source provenance and generation.
Active Page with matching PageRevision and no PageCategoryIndexState row; no memberships. Must remain distinguishable from a verified empty index.
Active Page and matching PageRevision; Verified index state at the current revision; at least one membership with the same generation, revision and source provenance.
One active and one deleted Page, with state fields consistent with Page constraints; category reads exclude deleted pages and return Unknown/PageUnavailable for direct deleted-page index inspection.
A deterministic operation/checkpoint plus ordered audit events covering intent, attempted/committed outcome, sequence continuity, event-ID and event-key uniqueness, and an expected version/policy.
Separate issued, consumed and revoked grant records with corresponding ordered audit events; preserve single-use/replay, version/CAS, validity, revocation and correlation fields.

FixtureSemantics: Missing PageCategoryIndexState means Unindexed; it is not an indexed empty set.
Verified state at current Page.Revision is Current; older verified revision is Stale; Incomplete, Failed and Unknown remain distinct fail-closed states.
Membership rows are only trusted when their verified state, source revision, generation and provenance align.
Do not export source page bodies or private category rows to readiness evidence; report only bounded aggregate checks and pass/fail codes.

DDLAndWritesRequired.DDL: Apply Page V1/V2/V3 and Category V1/V2/V3 only if absent/incompatible; each requires separate explicit migration authorization and a schema/target plan.
DDLAndWritesRequired.DML: Insert the bounded synthetic Page/PageRevision/index/membership/recovery/audit/grant fixture set; update/delete fixture rows only if separately specified and authorized.
DDLAndWritesRequired.RehearsalRunnerSupport: NONE; it rejects source seeding and performs no migration or fixture writes.

AuthorizationGapRegister.Operation: Page V1/V2/V3 and Category V1/V2/V3 migrations

InspectionPlan.Targets: Exact retained CW-M5-026B source and destination only; reconfirm runtime identities on host immediately before connection.

CredentialTransport.Required: Owner-owned 0600 client option files or an already approved OS secret-store adapter.
CredentialTransport.HistoricalProvisionerCreated: 0600 environment.env and application.env files in 0700 directories.
CredentialTransport.Compatibility: Those environment files are not MariaDB client option files; the rehearsal runner's --defaults-extra-file requirement is not established by the provisioning evidence.

PlannedReadOnlySql.ReportOutput: MATCH/MISMATCH codes only; do not persist raw CURRENT_USER or output.

PlannedReadOnlySql.Handling: Read output in memory only; persist booleans/codes for global privileges, grant option, schema confinement and role/unscoped grants; never persist grant text.

PlannedReadOnlySql.Sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE, COALESCE(ENGINE,'') FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE;
PlannedReadOnlySql.Handling: Compare to static migration inventory; report counts/missing object names only.

PlannedReadOnlySql.Sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE, COLUMN_KEY FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION;
PlannedReadOnlySql.Handling: Compare exact required structural metadata; no row values.

PlannedReadOnlySql.Sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, INDEX_NAME, NON_UNIQUE, SEQ_IN_INDEX, COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, INDEX_NAME, SEQ_IN_INDEX;
PlannedReadOnlySql.Handling: Compare primary, unique and secondary index metadata.

PlannedReadOnlySql.Sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME, CONSTRAINT_TYPE, REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME;
PlannedReadOnlySql.Handling: Compare foreign/unique/check constraints and referenced tables.

PlannedReadOnlySql.Sql: SELECT 'pages' AS ledger_domain, Version FROM MySqlPageSchemaVersion WHERE Domain='pages' UNION ALL SELECT 'page-support', Version FROM MySqlPageSchemaVersion WHERE Domain='page-support' UNION ALL SELECT 'deleted-revisions', Version FROM MySqlPageSchemaVersion WHERE Domain='deleted-revisions' UNION ALL SELECT 'category', Version FROM MySqlCategorySchemaVersion WHERE Domain='category' UNION ALL SELECT 'category-recovery', Version FROM MySqlCategorySchemaVersion WHERE Domain='category-recovery' UNION ALL SELECT 'category-admin-grants', Version FROM MySqlCategorySchemaVersion WHERE Domain='category-admin-grants';
PlannedReadOnlySql.Handling: Persist only expected domain/version match codes; no timestamps or data values.

PlannedReadOnlySql.Sql: SELECT 'Page' AS FixtureClass, COUNT(*) AS AggregateCount FROM Page UNION ALL SELECT 'PageRevision', COUNT(*) FROM PageRevision UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('IndexState:', IndexState), COUNT(*) FROM PageCategoryIndexState GROUP BY IndexState UNION ALL SELECT 'Membership', COUNT(*) FROM PageCategoryMembership UNION ALL SELECT 'RecoveryOperation', COUNT(*) FROM TwCategoryRecoveryOperation UNION ALL SELECT 'RecoveryAudit', COUNT(*) FROM TwCategoryRecoveryAuditEvent UNION ALL SELECT 'AdministrativeGrant', COUNT(*) FROM TwCategoryAdministrativeGrant UNION ALL SELECT 'AdministrativeGrantAudit', COUNT(*) FROM TwCategoryAdministrativeGrantAudit;
PlannedReadOnlySql.Handling: Aggregate counts and index-state counts only; do not export Page.Body, ScopeJson, grant details, or private row values.

PlannedReadOnlySql.Sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page P JOIN PageCategoryIndexState S ON S.PageId=P.Id WHERE P.IsDeleted=FALSE AND S.IndexState='Verified' AND S.IndexedPageRevision=P.Revision AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PageCategoryMembership M WHERE M.PageId=P.Id)) AS IndexedEmptyPages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page P LEFT JOIN PageCategoryIndexState S ON S.PageId=P.Id WHERE P.IsDeleted=FALSE AND S.PageId IS NULL) AS UnindexedPages, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT M.PageId) FROM PageCategoryMembership M JOIN Page P ON P.Id=M.PageId JOIN PageCategoryIndexState S ON S.PageId=P.Id WHERE P.IsDeleted=FALSE AND S.IndexState='Verified' AND S.IndexedPageRevision=P.Revision AND M.SourcePageRevision=P.Revision AND M.IndexGeneration=S.IndexGeneration) AS PopulatedCurrentPages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE IsDeleted=FALSE) AS ActivePages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE IsDeleted=TRUE) AS DeletedPages;
PlannedReadOnlySql.Handling: Returns aggregate counts distinguishing verified-empty, unindexed, current populated, active, and deleted pages; cannot prove a particular synthetic fixture exists without an approved fixture marker.

DestinationEmptiness.Sql: SELECT 'TABLES_OR_VIEWS' AS ObjectType, COUNT(*) AS ObjectCount FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() UNION ALL SELECT 'ROUTINES', COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() UNION ALL SELECT 'EVENTS', COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.EVENTS WHERE EVENT_SCHEMA=DATABASE() UNION ALL SELECT 'TRIGGERS', COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA=DATABASE();
DestinationEmptiness.Requirement: All counts must be zero before considering a future restore; report counts only. The current restore runner independently checks base tables only.

RunnerLimitations: The current runner does not apply migrations or seed test fixtures.
The current runner requires all ten base tables and InnoDB, and only compares table/engine inventories plus per-table dump content hashes.
It does not validate schema columns, indexes, foreign keys, schema ledger versions, page/category provenance, recovery checkpoints/audits, or administrative-grant/audit semantics.
Its destination emptiness check counts base tables only; this readiness plan requires broader object inventory before any future restore.
A content-hash match is not schema/recovery certification and does not prove historical data provenance or point-in-time recovery.
